body:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty: P1 triggered for tenant=Silverpine - dedicated VPC pool 'silverpine-dedicated-1' canary failures > 40% (5xx) on model-serving nodes. Triggered at 2025-06-10T14:00:34Z. Paging on-call.
Asha (SRE): I'm taking this. seeing 502/504 bursts on canary shard, latency spikes after token 32. initial suspect: pinned artifact we rolled this morning.
Ben (Eng Runtime): on it. which artifact did we pin for Silverpine canary? I have logs showing KV cache mismatches.
Asha (SRE): artifact id pinned in rollout: sha256:7f3b2c9a (pinned at 2025-06-10T08:12Z). previous stable artifact: sha256:4d1a9f22.
Li (Oncall-APAC): I'm on standby for rollback window if needed. current error % ~43% across canary (5 instances), non-canary customers not affected yet.
Ben (Eng Runtime): repro on my side. stacktrace points to aten kernel fallback on quantized path, causing OOM+timeouts on the canary nodes.
Asha (SRE): plan proposal: abort canary rollout, pin tenant to previous artifact (4d1a9f22) and restart canary nodes. Also isolate tenant traffic to prevent bleed. Agree? :thumbsup:
Marco (Customer Success): looping in Silverpine CSM. they'll want ETA and confirm if any data plane changes. I'll draft communication once we have ETA.
Eve (Security): quick Q — any risk of secret/key rotations during revert? Are we touching KMS? I assume no but want callout.
Ben (Eng Runtime): no KMS changes. it's artifact swap + rolling restart. steps below.
Ben (Eng Runtime): rollback commands (run from ops bastion):
```
# pin tenant artifact back to stable
redwoodctl tenant set-artifact --tenant silverpine --artifact sha256:4d1a9f22 --reason "emergency revert canary regression"
# restart canary nodes for tenant
redwoodctl infra restart-nodes --pool silverpine-dedicated-1 --filter "role=canary"
```
Asha (SRE): I'll run the pin, Ben do the restart after pin succeeds. Li will monitor metrics and circuit-breaker. Marco please prepare a short message for customer.
Li (Oncall-APAC): watching metrics now -> creating temporary traffic-split rule to divert all production traffic off canary: `routingctl set-split --tenant silverpine --canary 0`.
pagerduty: @Asha (SRE) acknowledged the alert (P1). Incident state: acknowledged. Assigned to Asha.
Asha (SRE): running pin now.
Asha (SRE): (run) `redwoodctl tenant set-artifact --tenant silverpine --artifact sha256:4d1a9f22 --reason "emergency revert"` -> response: success. new pinned artifact: 4d1a9f22.
Ben (Eng Runtime): restarting canary nodes now. command:
```
redwoodctl infra restart-nodes --pool silverpine-dedicated-1 --filter "role=canary" --grace 30s
```
Ben (Eng Runtime): restart in progress, rolling 5 nodes, ~10s drain per node.
Li (Oncall-APAC): metrics trending back to baseline. 5xx rate down to 3% on canary after first node replaced. latency normalized.
Marco (Customer Success): draft message for Silverpine (for review): "We detected elevated errors on the canary of your dedicated VPC pool this morning and have reverted to the previous verified model artifact. No customer data was at risk. We will continue to monitor and will follow up with a timeline for a safe re-roll." Thoughts?
Eve (Security): message looks fine. recommend adding that we did not change any key management settings and all audit logs preserved.
Asha (SRE): agreed. Marco add the KMS line. I'll keep the thread updated and handoff to Li in 30m for follow-up.
Li (Oncall-APAC): I'll own the follow-up and post a 1h health update. For now circuits closed, keeping canary at pinned artifact.
Ben (Eng Runtime): filing a follow-up bug for kernel fallback on quantized path + artifact test regressions: BUG-2025-311. linking traces and flamegraphs.
Asha (SRE): incident impact: P1 -> Silverpine canary only. No broader customer impact. Mitigation: pinned back to sha256:4d1a9f22, canary restarted, traffic diverted. ETA to close incident: 60m for verification.
Marco (Customer Success): message sent to Silverpine CSM slack and an email to their SREs. they replied "thanks, please keep us posted".
Li (Oncall-APAC): leaving a short runbook snippet for postmortem:
- verify artifact health across canary for 2x median request load
- run `evals/sanity/artifact_regression.sh sha256:7f3b2c9a` to reproduce locally
- coordinate with runtime eng for kernel patch

Asha (SRE): handing off to Li at 2025-06-10T14:56Z. I'll be reachable for questions. Closing pings to PD.
Li (Oncall-APAC): taking over. I'll update again at 15:30Z or earlier if instability returns. :white_check_mark:
